# Variable `SPL_SIGN_KEYNAME`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

The name of keys used by the uboot-sign class for signing U-Boot FIT image stored in the SPL_SIGN_KEYDIR directory. If we have for example a `dev.key` key and a `dev.crt` certificate stored in the SPL_SIGN_KEYDIR directory, you will have to set SPL_SIGN_KEYNAME to `dev`.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SPL_SIGN_KEYNAME
